pre_write.input: PreWriteEvent { event, workspace_root, timestamp, path, content: Option<String>, operation }
pre_write.output: PreVerdict { decision: allow|deny, report_reason, rule_id, fix }

session_start.output: SessionVerdict { system_message, detected: SessionDetected { package_json, package_json_unreadable, deps, gates } }

post_write.input: PostWriteEvent { event, workspace_root, timestamp, path, content: Option<String>, operation }
post_write.output: () — verdict-free by contract; appends PendingIssue { ts, path, rule_id, message, fix } lines

stop.archive_semantics: continue archives reported lines to issues-archive.jsonl and truncates pending-issues.jsonl

rules_source: rules-table.json severity=deny (8 rules) + severity=warn (9 rules), compiled in verbatim
